downside.story: P10: carrier FTTH programs slow after AT&T lowers 2027-28 capital investment to $22-23B and peers see deferrals (MasTec Communications backlog -7.5% q/q); Communications NTM backlog 13% below base (book-to-bill <1 for a year, includes our ~6%/yr trim), Communications margin -200bp (labor, under-absorbed crews, carrier pricing pressure after AT&T-Lumen and Verizon-Frontier consolidation), data-center electrical share -25% and margin -300bp as lead-time pricing normalises; multiples -2.5 turns.

upside.story: P90: wireless deferral recaptured in FY28 on top of BEAD construction and long-haul/middle-mile awards (NTM backlog +8%), Communications margin +100bp from operating leverage, Building Systems adds electricians and keeps share (+20%) as data-center construction (Census +90% y/y in Sep-26) keeps rising; multiple recovers 3.5 turns toward the peer median.

downside.story: 10th percentile: my lower backlog path (about -5% vs the approved one by FY29: AT&T 2027-28 capital investment cut to $22-23B a year, MasTec Communications backlog -7.5% q/q with customer deferrals) plus a real carrier program cut at AT&T or Verizon (NTM backlog -14% vs the approved path, book-to-bill under 1); Communications margin -200bp as crews are under-absorbed (MasTec Communications EBITDA margin 6.7%, -460bp y/y) and Verizon/Frontier pricing pressure; data-center electrical slips (BS share -25%, BS margin -300bp as Power Solutions estimate gains reverse); the P/E de-rates 3 turns to ~10x.

upside.story: 90th percentile: the ~$150M deferred wireless and BEAD construction land in FY28 with hyperscaler long-haul awards (Lumen PCF, Corning multi-year optical agreements), NTM backlog +8% vs the approved path, Communications margin +100bp on volume, Building Systems share +15% as 2027 hyperscaler capex rises, and the P/E recovers 3 turns toward the peer median (~16x).

downside.story: 10th percentile, against the approved set: my skeptic driver view (backlog ~6%/yr instead of ~10%, flat Communications margin, Building Systems 19%) plus a carrier program cut on top of the October 2026 resets. AT&T (20.1% of revenue) spends at the low end of its lowered $22-23B and slows non-fiber work, Verizon/Frontier (10.4%) holds capex flat as it did in 2026 (9M capex -3% y/y), the ~$150M wireless deferral does not return in FY28: Communications NTM backlog 17% below the set by FY29 (MasTec's Communications backlog fell 7.5% in one quarter). Communications margin -225bp (MasTec's fell 460bp y/y to 6.7% on deferrals; 2018-19 DY precedent). The data-center cycle pauses for a year: Building Systems share -20%, margin -400bp to ~16% (Power Solutions' first 'mid-teens' guide). The market pays ~10.2x NTM EPS, the trough of the cycle range.

upside.story: 90th percentile: the wireless deferral returns in FY28 with BEAD construction 'in earnest' and long-haul/middle-mile awards converting (>$1B contracted, ~$20B TAM back-half weighted), NTM backlog 4% above the approved path, Communications margin +50bp above it (back to FY26 levels), Building Systems gains 15% share in a data-center market growing with hyperscaler capex, and the multiple re-rates to ~15.7x NTM as the October AI-infrastructure sell-off reverses (still below the 18.65x peer median).

downside.story: P10: carrier fiber retrenchment spreads beyond AT&T's 2027-28 capex trim (Verizon sets a lower 2027 budget, AT&T presses unit pricing as MasTec's Communications margin fell 460bp to 6.7%): NTM Communications backlog 15% below the approved path (this carries my +8%/+6% trim plus a carrier cut), Communications margin -200bp; data-center orders pause (Building Systems share -25%, margin -300bp); P/E and EV/EBITDA de-rate a further 2.5 turns as the market prices peak FTTH.

upside.story: P90: BEAD construction (>270,000 route miles, ~58% buried) and long-haul hyperscaler fiber ramp on schedule, the ~$150M wireless recapture lands in FY28, NTM backlog +7% vs path, Communications margin +80bp on operating leverage; Building Systems share +15% and margin +100bp in a data-center market still growing 25%+; multiples recover 2.5 turns toward the peer median.

downside.story: 10th percentile: carriers cut or re-phase fiber programs (AT&T 2027-28 capex already trimmed; MasTec-style Communications deferrals reach DY), NTM backlog 12% below path, Communications margin -200bp on carrier consolidation pricing, data-center work pauses (standing AI-capex low case), Building Systems share -30% and margin -300bp; multiples compress 2.5 turns to P/E 10.7x / EV/EBITDA 8.4x, near DY's 2019 trough.

upside.story: 90th percentile: BEAD construction and long-haul/AI fiber ramp lift NTM backlog 8% above path, wireless deferral recaptured in FY28, Communications margin +100bp, Building Systems share +15% as labor is added; AI-capex fear fades and multiples re-rate 3.5 turns (P/E 16.7x, still below the 18.65x peer median; EV/EBITDA 14.4x).

downside.story: P10: the four agents' dissent plays out and worse: AT&T (11.0% of receivables and contract assets at 2026-08-01, 10-Q note 6) cuts 2027-28 capital investment to $22-23B (8-K 2026-10-21) and carriers keep deferring as at MasTec (Communications backlog -7.5% q/q, 2026-10-29); NTM Communications backlog 14% below the approved path (book-to-bill under 1 for about a year), Communications margin -200bp on under-absorbed crews and fuel, data-center electrical share -25% and margin -300bp as lead-time pricing normalises; P/E and EV/EBITDA 2.5 turns lower.

upside.story: P90: the ~$150M wireless deferral comes back in FY28 on top of BEAD construction and long-haul awards (backlog +8%), Communications margin +100bp from operating leverage, Building Systems adds electricians and holds share (+20%) as data-center construction keeps rising; multiples recover 3 turns toward the peer median.
